<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        // Handle Dropdown Hover Logic
        const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll(".dropdown-container");

        dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
            const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".dropdown-list-item");
            const mediaGroups = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".media-group");

            const showDefaultCards = function () {
                items.forEach(li => li.classList.remove("active"));

                const parentGroup = dropdown.querySelector(".parent-media-group");
                const childGroups = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".child-media-group");

                childGroups.forEach(group => group.style.display = "none");
                const parentHasCards =
                    parentGroup &&
                    parentGroup.querySelectorAll(".media-item").length > 0;
                if (parentHasCards) {
                    parentGroup.style.display = "flex";
                } else {
                    if (parentGroup) {
                        parentGroup.style.display = "none";
                    }

                    const firstChildWithCards = Array.from(childGroups).find(group =>
                        group.querySelectorAll(".media-item").length > 0
                    );

                    if (firstChildWithCards) {
                        firstChildWithCards.style.display = "flex";

                        const index = firstChildWithCards.getAttribute("data-media-group-id");
                        const matchingItem = dropdown.querySelector(`.dropdown-list-item[data-media-index="${index}"]`);

                        if (matchingItem) {
                            matchingItem.classList.add("active");
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            if (items.length && mediaGroups.length) {
                showDefaultCards();
            }

            const parentButton = dropdown.previousElementSibling;

            if (parentButton && parentButton.classList.contains("drop-down-link")) {
                parentButton.addEventListener("mouseenter", showDefaultCards);
                parentButton.addEventListener("focus", showDefaultCards);
            }

            items.forEach(item => {
                const activateItem = function () {
                    const index = item.getAttribute("data-media-index");

                    items.forEach(li => li.classList.remove("active"));
                    item.classList.add("active");

                    const parentGroup = dropdown.querySelector(".parent-media-group");
                    const childGroups = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".child-media-group");

                    childGroups.forEach(group => group.style.display = "none");

                    const activeChildGroup = dropdown.querySelector(`.child-media-group[data-media-group-id="${index}"]`);

                    const hasChildCards =
                        activeChildGroup &&
                        activeChildGroup.querySelectorAll(".media-item").length > 0;

                    if (hasChildCards) {
                        if (parentGroup) {
                            parentGroup.style.display = "none";
                        }

                        activeChildGroup.style.display = "flex";
                    } else {
                        const parentHasCards =
                            parentGroup &&
                            parentGroup.querySelectorAll(".media-item").length > 0;

                        if (parentHasCards) {
                            parentGroup.style.display = "flex";
                        } else {
                            showDefaultCards();
                        }
                    }
                };

                item.addEventListener("mouseenter", activateItem);

                item.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
                    const parentGroup = dropdown.querySelector(".parent-media-group");

                    // If NO parent cards → restore default child cards
                    const parentHasCards =
                        parentGroup &&
                        parentGroup.querySelectorAll(".media-item").length > 0;

                    if (!parentHasCards) {
                        showDefaultCards();
                    }
                });
                item.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        activateItem();
                    }
                });

                item.addEventListener("click", activateItem);
            });
        });

        // Mobile Hero Adjuster
        (function () {
            const heroSlider = document.querySelector('.plp-hero-slider-wrapper');
            const hiddenItems = document.querySelectorAll('li.digex-hidden-on-mobile').length;
            if (window.innerWidth < 768 && hiddenItems && heroSlider) {
                heroSlider.style.position = 'relative';
                heroSlider.style.top = '-35px';
            }
        })();
    });
</script>

            Authentic local feel with exceptional service

            Omni Hotels & Resorts exists to give guests an authentic feel for the local flavor in leading business gateways and leisure destinations across North America. From exceptional golf and spa retreats to dynamic business settings, each Omni property blends seamlessly into the local culture while featuring four-diamond services, signature restaurants, WiFi connectivity and unique wellness options.

            At Omni, we dedicate ourselves to leaving a lasting impression with every guest through award-winning, personalized service. And to demonstrate our appreciation to those who are loyal to us, we offer a heightened level of recognition and rewards through our Select Guest® loyalty program and the company’s Power of All associate empowerment program.

            ENVIRONMENTAL STEWARDSHIP

            With a thoughtful and responsible plan, Omni Hotels & Resorts is doing its part to sustain a healthy balance of natural resources in our world while ensuring future generations will have abundant resources to enjoy. As an innovative community partner, Omni is leading by example — showing local communities what corporate social responsibility should look like. At the same time, our organization remains focused on providing our guests and clients with the luxury experiences they expect. We encourage our guests to join our efforts and take part in the simple and practical actions we undertake to help sustain our valuable resources.

            FOOD & BEVERAGE
            WE ACTIVELY:

            • Source food and beverage options on a local level as often as possible allowing us to reduce the carbon footprint of culinary options we offer
            • Offer a “farm-to-table” approach with the option of requesting organic produce
            • Reduce the use of plastic water bottles for meetings and events
            • Work with our group clients and local organizations to arrange for donation of leftover and excess food items in a safe manner to local food banks and shelters

            ENERGY
            WE ACTIVELY:

            • Explore the use of hybrid vehicles for all new purchases and/or leases
            • Utilize more energy efficient laundry processes
            • Utilize LED light bulbs in all new build and renovated hotels while methodologically converting all other hotels to more energy efficient lighting options
            • Remind associates to turn off unused lights and reduce HVAC usage
            • Install energy efficient systems in all new buildings
            • Encourage staff to use mass transportation and/or carpooling options

            RECYCLING
            WE ACTIVELY:

            • Provide bulk shower dispensers to reduce single use plastics
            • Print on Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certified or recycled
              paper whenever possible and aim to reduce the use of paper
              within our organization
            • Recycle plastic, glass, paper and cardboard in all communities where recycling is readily available
            • Provide recycling

            AIR QUALITY
            WE ACTIVELY:

            • Work with vendors and partners to reduce our carbon footprint for procurement activities
            • Create green roofs
            • Plant trees for major milestones and celebrations

            CHEMICALS
            WE ACTIVELY:

            • Utilize more ecologically-friendly laundry processes
            • Create natural herb gardens with native plants

            WATER
            WE ACTIVELY:

            • Utilize more efficient laundry services
            • Reduce laundry services by changing bed linens and towels every three days, unless requested otherwise. Towels that are hung will not be replaced
            • Consider the most efficient systems in all new build and renovated hotels and resorts
